nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic (implementation) contract that the proxy delegatecalls into.
Constructor that stores the logic address and performs an initial delegatecall with supplied initialization calldata.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls all calldata to the stored logic address via inline assembly.
Constructor parameter holding the logic contract address.
Constructor parameter holding arbitrary calldata forwarded to the logic contract during initialization.
Local boolean capturing the success flag returned by the constructor delegatecall.
Local bytes holding the raw return/revert data of the constructor delegatecall.
Local copy of the logic address used as delegatecall target inside the fallback.
Low-level delegatecall executed in the constructor against an externally supplied logic address and calldata.
Assembly delegatecall executed in the fallback forwarding attacker-controlled calldata to the logic address.

edges.reason: _logic parameter is consumed by the constructor to determine the delegatecall target.
Constructor writes the immutable logic state variable from its argument.
_initializationCalldata is passed directly as the calldata of the constructor delegatecall.
The constructor is the execution context that performs the initialization delegatecall.
_logic supplies the target address of the constructor delegatecall.
The delegatecall success flag is stored in local variable _ok.
The delegatecall return data is stored in local variable returnData and used in the require revert string.
The logic state variable is read in the fallback to select the delegatecall implementation address.
The fallback function body executes the assembly delegatecall.
The fallback copies the logic address into the local _impl before delegating.
_impl is the runtime delegatecall target used by the fallback assembly block.
The fallback delegatecalls into arbitrary logic selected at deployment, which can execute external calls and re-enter the proxy fallback before state effects settle.

normalization_plan.reason: _logic is a constructor parameter whose only role is to feed the constructor and its delegatecall; fold it into the constructor node.
_initializationCalldata is a constructor parameter passed straight into the initialization delegatecall; fold it into the unsafe_operation node.
_ok is a transient local holding the delegatecall success flag; fold it into the delegatecall_constructor unsafe_operation.
returnData is a transient local holding delegatecall revert data; fold it into the delegatecall_constructor unsafe_operation.
_impl is a transient local copy of logic used only as the fallback delegatecall target; fold it into the delegatecall_fallback unsafe_operation.
